blurb: The Port Hueneme Historical Museum is located at 220 N Market Street in Port Hueneme. Built in 1925, the building was originally the Bank of Hueneme, then it was the city’s first City Hall. Today, the Museum - listed as Ventura County Landmark No. 32 - houses historical artifacts, photographs, and information on the history of the Hueneme area.
